L107: Working with Devin
L108: # Devin voice mode
L109: 
L110: Use Devin voice mode to talk through ideas, pressure-test an approach, and hand off work. Learn how to start and control a call.
L111: 
L112: Copy page Copy page
L113: 
L114: With voice mode, you can talk naturally with Devin to explore ideas, pressure-test approaches, and hand off work while you’re away from your keyboard.
L115: ##
L116: 
L117: cite66†​ L118: 
L119: Start a call
L120: 
L121: Click the voice call button beside the message box on the home page in Agent mode or in an existing session, then allow microphone access. Any message you’ve typed is sent when you start the call.
L122: 
L123: cite67†Image: Devin message box with the pointer over the waveform icon and the Start voice call tooltip visible.†mintcdn.com L124: 
L125: Hover over the waveform icon to see “Start voice call.”
L126: ##
L127: 
L128: cite68†​ L129: 
L130: During a call
L131: 
L132:   * Mute microphone pauses your microphone. Click Unmute microphone to speak again.
L133:   * Hold Space to talk while muted when you’re not typing.
L134:   * Silence Devin turns off Devin’s audio without muting your microphone. Click Unsilence Devin to hear Devin again.
L135:   * End voice call hangs up.
L136: You can navigate within Devin while the call stays connected. Your conversation appears in the session history.
L137: ##
L138: 
L139: cite69†​ L140: 
L141: Tips
L142: 
L143:   * Don’t be afraid to interrupt Devin’s work, ask questions and clarify your thoughts as you have them.
L144:   * Feel free to interrupt Devin while it is talking.
L145:   * If you have preferences for how Devin should speak (e.g. speak faster or slower, communication style) just ask!
